quota_definition: keep base top-K covered/uncovered counts; rank within groups with mixed full/rule scores; no labels at prediction
tifu_scope: author released implementation temporal frequency and Euclidean neighbors; paper/code grouping and within-decay discrepancy explicitly documented; training-only neighbor bank; restrict ranking to personal historical candidates, not full-basket paper replication; original paper Instacart m3/rb.9/rg.7/k900/alpha.9 included
selection: maximum validation mean per-user repeat Recall@10, learned methods averaged over three model seeds; ties favor lower quota weight / alpha1 then fewer neighbors
history_diagnostics: six fixed specifications: original/finer/coarser bins x minimum cell group count 10/20; long minus short bootstrap with fixed support and weights; raw overall and raw same-support separately; descriptive not causal
rule_diagnostics: coverage targets and exact additive covered/uncovered contributions with shared all-repeat denominator; exploratory
claims: course-level empirical extension and constrained reranking design; no claim of globally novel algorithm, causal effect, or SOTA
stop_rule: all specified comparisons on fresh confirmation; independent audit; update evidence and demo; accept null outcomes without tuning confirmation
